title: Native adic bidual as a transpose
statement: For a prime ℓ, any scheme X and any native adic module M, define its dual by the native internal Hom into the regular module. The transpose of the identity of the dual is a morphism M → D(D(M)), and its uncurrying is native evaluation with the two factors interchanged by the braiding. No bidual invertibility is asserted.

source.place: Tag 03EO; formal transpose-uncurry identity in the native symmetric tensor-Hom adjunction.

proof.text: Take the transpose of the identity of the dual. Apply the native transpose-uncurry identity. Remove identity composition and identity whiskering to obtain exactly braided evaluation.

proof_origin.place: Explicit native/sectionwise comparison using the cited universal properties and canonical localization maps.

lean.statement:
theorem adicNativeBidual_transpose {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (M : AdicSheaf l X) :
    (adicNativeBidual M).hom ▷ ((AdicSheaf.ihom M).obj (AdicSheaf.unit l X)).X ≫
        Mod.evaluation ((AdicSheaf.ihom M).obj (AdicSheaf.unit l X)) (AdicSheaf.unit l X) =
      (β_ M.X ((AdicSheaf.ihom M).obj (AdicSheaf.unit l X)).X).hom ≫
        Mod.evaluation M (AdicSheaf.unit l X)
